verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Daniel 5

Belshazzar eldest son of Nabonidus and co-regent from 553 BC (Nabonidus Cylinder, BM); "father" = grandfather or predecessor; third ruler because Belshazzar was second; mene/tekel/peres read as verbs (after Adam Clarke); Herodotus on the diverted Euphrates; Darius the Mede = Gubaru, a sub-king under Cyrus; cites Isa 44:28–45:7 and Jer 51:57–58 as fulfilled
